description: SMART configuration must be discoverable at .well-known/smart-configuration
remediation_hint: Ensure your FHIR server exposes .well-known/smart-configuration with a valid JSON body.

description: Server must support PKCE S256 code challenge method
Access token must include all requested scopes (patient/*.read minimum)
remediation_hint: Ensure authorization server grants at minimum patient/*.read scope.

description: Server must advertise launch-ehr and launch-standalone capabilities
remediation_hint: Add launch-ehr and launch-standalone to capabilities array in .well-known/smart-configuration.

description: Token response must include patient context and openid/fhirUser claims
remediation_hint: Verify your app requests openid fhirUser scopes and that the token response includes a patient field.
